name: apple-mail
description: Manage Apple Mail through natural language - read, search, send, reply, forward, and organize emails and mailboxes, with diagnostics, attachments, templates, and mail-merge support (macOS only).

interface.shortDescription: Read, search, send, and organize Apple Mail.
interface.longDescription: A macOS-only Apple Mail connector for Codex that uses the apple-mail-mcp server to read, search, send, reply to, forward, and organize emails and mailboxes across Apple Mail accounts, with diagnostics, attachment, template, contact lookup, and mail-merge support.
defaultPrompt: Check my inbox and summarize any unread emails.
Find emails from Sarah about the budget.
Draft a reply to the latest message from my manager.
